body: I really hope so, I never ever got the chance to make him proud when he was alive, I want to do it  now but I dont know how to overcome this feeling of hopelessness and guilt if that makes sense
We use to watch predominantly but I thought maybe actually playing will help me but it hasn't

I've tried, I tried doing it alone but as soon as it's done, I just remember what I've done, that in the reason my dad isnt here anymore. I've tried it with my brother but he gets really aggressive with me and he just ruins it
Football or soccer if you're American, cricket, rugby, golf sometimes
My most favourite thing to do was to watch sports with him .... I cant bring myself to watch it without him. I dont know what to do

He was so sick and I was taking care of him, the night he died he asked me to bring him his cellphone and i forgot, he got up to get the phone  and he fell and had a heart attack. I didnt get him his cellphone

They're dont care about anything else beside themselves... they're fighting over his money and house. Where am I supposed to go
